procedure.method: I read the explicitly pinned packet, case, rules, rubric, ratio policy, both native-evidence manifests, summarize.py and run_agent.py, and verified all 15 supplied byte counts and SHA-256 hashes. I inspected the returned images from six separate tools.view_image calls through functions.exec, using detail original and forwarding each image at original detail: R7-B03-M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320, then R7-B03-M2 native, usage720, thumbnail320. All six exact views were seen before my first transcription judgment, any image score or diversity score. There were no source assets or protected-layout manifests declared. No revisit, generation, editing, peer-review access, spawning, fork or resume was used. I checked PNG IHDR dimensions and opaque RGB color type for the six pinned PNGs. Session identity and runner trace provenance are not observable here and are not claimed.

The wide desk diagonal, horizontal mechanism and upper copy occupy distinct bands. The desk front is a sizable quiet area, with the material and footer groups anchoring it.

image_material.location: finger nail/skin, silver axle face, beveled black lever and base
image_material.observation: The nail sheen, skin creases, circular machining on the silver axle, narrow hard edge highlights and soft contact shadows produce a convincing macro product photograph. The body is black with a low-gloss finish; the pads are thicker, dark contact pieces.

image_material.location: right of axle, upper and lower rubber pads with white sheet between their levels
image_material.observation: Both opposing pads and their separation can be seen. The single sheet edge is distinct from the desk and does not erase the upper jaw or the silver pivot.

image_material.location: black desk wrap at far left and broad base below the axle
image_material.observation: The coating has conspicuous curling grain on broad black surfaces. It is a minor limitation in aluminum specificity; the rigid bend, thin bevel highlights and separate padded faces still make the construction readable.
The shallow-focus backdrop and wood detail remain coherent. The black body, silver pivot and white sheet have enough tonal separation to read the action.

emotion_control.location: finger pressing the clip on a pale wooden desk
emotion_control.observation: The warm desk, close hand contact and restrained black hardware communicate easy everyday use. The visible open receiving gap supports the promise of one-handed operation.

emotion_control.location: hand-to-product contact and simple light background
emotion_control.observation: The close crop feels practical and tactile. The bold title supplies emphasis without competing with a theatrical lighting effect or an unrelated emotional motif.

ai_slop.location: lever, axle, two pads and desk wrap
ai_slop.observation: The parts maintain a coherent press-and-open relationship: the finger is on the lever side, the jaws are on the other side, and one silver axle is visible. No extra floating metal part or duplicated jaw appears.

ai_slop.location: white note edge and finger contact
ai_slop.observation: The sheet is a single coherent plane, and the nail and fingertip meet the lever visibly. The dark curling coating texture is the main local finish reservation; it does not create an extra component.
